description_en: Cancels upgrade jobs for devices that are in the pending state under a specified firmware

kebab_example: aliyun iot cancel-ota-task-by-device --firmware-id T0F5b5tpFnHQrgfk0000030100 --product-key a1V4kde0000 --device-name example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelOTATaskByDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If <props="intl"><ph>the Overview page or </ph></props>this parameter is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the over-the-air update package, which is the unique identity of the OTA upgrade package.

The firmware ID is one of the parameters returned when you invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html to create an OTA upgrade package.

You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147450.html to view the firmware ID from the response
parameters.help_zh:
OTA升级包ID，OTA升级包的唯一标识符。

OTA升级包ID是调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html创建OTA升级包时，返回的参数之一。

可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147450.html，从返回参数中查看
parameters.name: firmware_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device whose upgrade you want to cancel belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要取消升级的设备所属产品的ProductKey
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the upgrade batch. If you specify this parameter, only the device upgrade jobs in the specified batch are canceled.
The batch ID is the JobId returned after you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147480.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html, or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html to create an upgrade job. You can also view the batch ID on the Firmware Details page of the firmware in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh:
升级批次ID。传入此参数则只取消指定批次下的设备升级任务。
批次ID是您调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147480.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html创建升级任务后返回的**JobId**。您也可以在物联网平台控制台上固件的**固件详情**页查看
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the device whose upgrade you want to cancel.

Device names must be unique.

You can specify up to 200 device names
parameters.help_zh:
要取消升级的设备名称。

设备名称不能重复。

最多可传入200个设备名称
parameters.name: device_name
